en.description: Local War Thunder knowledge plus live battle commentary. A searchable, updatable knowledge base covering concepts, vehicles and play; reads the local 8111 telemetry for sitreps, kill cheers and comeback lines; falls back to screenshot OCR when telemetry is unavailable; copy follows the persona you set, with a configurable model and spend caps.
